Lemma
Source: topping:page-0117, topping:page-0118 1. ch9:7.2\group curvature-pinching For symmetric endomorphisms of $\mathbb R^3$, the trace $\lambda _1+\lambda _2+\lambda _3$ is linear and the smallest eigenvalue $\lambda _1$ is concave. Hence $\lambda _3$, $\lambda _1+\lambda _2$, and $\lambda _3-\lambda _1$ are respectively convex, concave, and convex. If $\alpha $ is concave and $\beta $ is concave and increasing, then $\beta \circ \alpha $ is concave wherever it is defined.
